_comment: Known-failing pytest tests (#4562). CI fails on any failure NOT listed here. Regenerate with: python scripts/check_pytest_baseline.py <junit.xml> --update. #5169, #5175, #5255, #5257, #5284, #5287, #5288, #5289, #5290, #5291, #5292, #5295, #5419, and #5225 removed obsolete or newly passing entries by hand, as did #5811 (38 entries: 36 tests that run and pass, and 2 that no longer exist — --strict-stale cannot see the latter): --strict-stale (#5091) fails the job on a baselined test that passes. #6657 removed 15 entries that only failed because CI had no `auralis_dsp` (they pass once the job builds it). #6708 removed 14 entries under tests/performance, tests/load_stress and tests/stress: those directories are marked slow and run only in the nightly slow-tests.yml job, so this per-push baseline can no longer see them pass or fail. #6598 removed 3 entries for tests/regression/test_frontend_hook_patterns.py, deleted in favour of behavioural vitest coverage. #6709 removed 11 entries that ran and passed in run 44944948134, the first completed run with auralis_dsp built (6 of them in test_cross_dimensional_interactions). #6709 follow-up removed the 2 test_data_migration TestUserPreferencesMigration entries: they asserted that add() keeps favorite/play_count, which only the scanner calls and a file never carries, and were rewritten to check the stats survive a rescan and a metadata edit. It also removed 4 entries that handed HybridProcessor.process() a file path (it takes decoded audio): those tests decode through tests/audio_processing.process_file now, and test_process_nonexistent_file became test_process_rejects_a_path_with_a_clear_error. It also removed the 2 test_fingerprint_keyboard_interrupt entries: they pinned the ThreadPoolExecutor the Rust engine replaced (871356f75); the file now pins that a KeyboardInterrupt from the engine reaches the caller unconverted. It also removed the 2 test_processing_parameters documentation entries: they fetched /openapi.json, which the dev-only /api/openapi.json replaced (#2418, #4375), and read app.openapi() now. It also removed test_no_raw_sql_leaks: its allowlist still named the manager.py #4915 deleted, so the PRAGMA setup and migration runner that replaced it read as leaks; every entry now carries its reason. #6653 removed the 9 test_version_compatibility entries: 5 were deleted (they read UnifiedConfig.sample_rate/config_data/bit_depth/processing_mode, which no longer exist), and 4 now pass (favorites set through set_favorite, the mode/default tests read the current API, output-format asserts sample-count preservation, determinism compares samples instead of a 2-D corrcoef). It also removed 5 one-offs: the aiofiles, Fernet and stop-event batch-cancellation tests exercised third-party libraries or test-local code and were deleted; the artwork test now checks update_artwork() is visible on the next reads; the very-quiet test expects -60 dB input left at its level (#5551 silence floor) and a sibling checks -40 dB is lifted. Removed rather than regenerated -- a baseline built outside CI reports spurious new failures.
